plan.title: Add surrogate bid on live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ's Participants tab as the buyer.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Add a surrogate bid of 95 for the eligible vendor; this step saves the bid but cannot enter the requested reference.
Confirm the surrogate bid submission was accepted.
Open the Responses view to verify the buyer sees the submitted bid.
Assert that one vendor response is shown and it is marked as a surrogate bid.
Open Master QCS to inspect the submitted bid in the comparison grid.
Confirm the Master QCS rate for the submitted bid is 95.
